Terms & Conditions — Vendor app

Version v1 · Last updated: September 15, 2026

1. Acceptance of these terms

These Terms & Conditions ("Terms") govern your use of the AbhiRam Fresh Mart Vendor app by a store ("Vendor", "you") partnered with AbhiRam FreshMart ("we", "us", "our") to sell products through the platform. By signing in and using this app, you agree to these Terms and to our Privacy Policy.

If you do not agree, please do not use the app.

2. Your vendor account

Vendor accounts are set up by our team when your store joins the platform; you sign in with the credentials we issue rather than self-registering. You are responsible for keeping your login credentials secure and for all activity under your account, including that of any staff you allow to use it.

You agree to keep your shop details, hours, and delivery radius accurate and up to date, since customers rely on this information when ordering.

3. Listings, pricing, and stock

You are responsible for the accuracy of the products, prices, descriptions, and stock levels you list, and for keeping stock levels current so customers aren't sold items you can't fulfil.

We may review, adjust categorisation of, or remove a listing that is inaccurate, prohibited, or violates applicable law.

4. Orders and fulfilment

When a customer places an order at your store, you'll be notified and are expected to accept or reject it, and to prepare accepted orders promptly for pickup by a delivery partner.

An order covering an unusually long delivery distance may be held for a brief manual review before a delivery partner is assigned; this is a routine platform check, not a reflection on your store.

You agree to hand over the correct items for each order. Repeated inaccurate fulfilment, cancellations, or delays may affect your store's standing on the platform.

5. Payments and commission

Customer payments are collected by our third-party payment provider. Your payout, less any applicable platform commission, is settled to you on the schedule and terms communicated to you separately when you joined the platform.

Promotions and coupons you configure for your store are applied per the eligibility conditions you set, and may be withdrawn or corrected if applied in error.

6. Acceptable use

You agree not to misuse the app — including listing prohibited or misrepresented items, manipulating stock or pricing to defraud customers, abusing promotions, attempting to interfere with the app's security or normal operation, or being abusive toward customers or delivery partners.

We may suspend or deactivate a vendor account we reasonably believe is engaged in fraud, abuse, or a violation of these Terms.

7. Your data

What we collect and how we use it is described in full in our Privacy Policy, which forms part of these Terms. In short: your account details, shop and catalog data, order data needed to fulfil customer orders, and performance analytics are used to operate the platform, and are not sold to advertisers.

If you are located in India, the Digital Personal Data Protection Act, 2023 gives you rights over your personal data, including access, correction, and erasure — see the Privacy Policy's "Your choices" section for how to exercise them.

8. Third-party services

The app relies on third-party services to operate — a payment processor (for customer checkout and vendor payouts), a cloud image host (for product and shop photos), and a push-notification service (for order alerts). Your interaction with those providers, where applicable, may also be subject to their own terms.

9. Limitation of liability

We provide the platform connecting your store to customers and delivery partners; while we take reasonable steps to keep the service reliable, we are not liable for indirect or consequential losses arising from a platform outage, a delivery delay, or a customer dispute, to the fullest extent permitted by law.

Nothing in these Terms limits any liability that cannot be excluded under Indian law.

10. Changes to these terms

We may update these Terms from time to time. If we make a material change, we'll update the "last updated" date above and, where required, ask you to re-accept before you can keep using the app.

11. Grievance redressal

Questions, complaints, or grievances about an order or these Terms can be raised with our Grievance Officer: [GRIEVANCE_OFFICER_NAME], abhiramfreshmartvmr@gmail.com. We aim to acknowledge complaints within 48 hours and resolve them within one month.

12. Governing law

These Terms are governed by the laws of India. Any dispute arising out of or in connection with these Terms will be subject to the exclusive jurisdiction of the courts of Nellore, Andhra Pradesh, India.
